rev1.author: Sarah Jenkins
rev1.text: The attention to detail here is unmatched. It feels like a high-end sanctuary, and my nails have never looked more elegant or lasted longer. Highly recommend!

rev2.author: Elena Rostova
rev2.text: I came for a facial and a manicure. The experience was absolutely heavenly. The luxury design, refined scent, and professional technicians made my day.

rev3.author: Amanda Miller
rev3.text: Averie delivers the perfect quiet luxury experience. It's clean, minimalist, and beautifully executed. Booking online is ultra-smooth!
